headline: Sensex gains over 500 points, Nifty nears 25,300 led by FII inflows, FMCG, and bank stocks

marketStatus.message: Market is open for trading today.

why: Foreign institutional investor (FII) inflows blunted global headwinds and provided strong support to Indian benchmark indices.
Strong performance in FMCG and banking sector shares boosted market sentiment.
The Indian Rupee rose while market volatility ebbed alongside persistent equity buying.
Early trading momentum in key blue-chip stocks helped Sensex surge past 500 points.
whatHappening: Sensex closed up by over 500 points while Nifty 50 ended near 25,291.
Max Healthcare emerged as the top gainer in today's trading session.
Sebi plans to issue a consultation paper proposing an increase in the FPI beneficial ownership threshold to 25%.
Swiggy was listed among ten midcap stocks that have dropped up to 50% in CY26.
summary: Indian stock markets ended higher today as foreign fund inflows lifted investor sentiment. Sensex gained over 510 points while Nifty closed near 25,300, led by gains in FMCG and banking stocks. Max Healthcare featured among top gainers, while Rupee strengthened amid easing volatility.
